description: Submit a screenshot capture request for a URL. Returns a token to poll with get_status. Supported formats: jpg (free), png, webp, webp_lossless, avif, pdf (Pro). Captures are private by default (not on the CDN; retrieve via the download URL from get_status, fetchable repeatedly until it auto-expires). Pass cdn=true for a permanent public CDN image URL instead. Use callback_url for async delivery so you don't need to poll.

autoplay_videos.description: Launch Chromium with --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required so unmuted <video autoplay> elements start playing without a user gesture. Useful for pages with hero videos. Pro only.

block_ads.description: Block ads and trackers. Pro only.

callback_secret.description: Shared secret echoed in callback payload for verification.

callback_url.description: HTTPS URL to POST the result to when done. Skips polling.

cdn.description: When true, publish the result to the public CDN and return a permanent image URL. Default: captures are private (not uploaded to the CDN); retrieve them via the download URL from get_status, which stays fetchable until it auto-expires after a short retention window.

cookies.description: Cookies injected before navigation (e.g. to capture pages behind a session). Max 50. Pro only.

crop_height.description: Custom output height in px, cropped from top. Max 30000. Pro only.

dismiss_cookies.description: Handle cookie banners automatically. Pro only.

emulate_print_media.description: Apply the page's print stylesheet (page.emulateMediaType("print")) before capture. Useful for capturing print layouts as an image. No additional effect on PDF (already in print mode). Pro only.

format.description: Output format. Default: jpg. png, webp, webp_lossless, avif, pdf require Pro (non-Pro accounts are limited to jpg).

frame.description: Decorative frame composited around the rendered image (ignored for PDF). Variants: rounded (corner-clipped, no padding), shadow (drop shadow + rounded corners), browser_chrome / browser_chrome_dark (browser window with traffic-lights + URL bar, light/dark), mobile/mobile_light (smartphone mockup, dark/light bezel), tablet/tablet_light (tablet mockup, dark/light bezel), laptop (laptop mockup), polaroid (white border + soft shadow), gradient (rounded screenshot on a lime-accent gradient backdrop), shotbot_brand (lime corner brackets). Free accounts get a tiny shotbot.fr/.net mark bottom-right on any non-empty frame. Pro accounts get a clean frame on ALL variants.

fullpage.description: Capture the full page height (max 30000 px). Default: false.

hidpi.description: Render at 2× device pixel ratio (retina / HiDPI). Doubles the output resolution.

http_auth.description: HTTP Basic Auth credentials for password-protected pages. Pro only.

nojs.description: Disable JavaScript before loading the page.

omit_background.description: Render with a transparent viewport backdrop (Chromium omitBackground). Visible on PNG/WebP/AVIF; JPG flattens to black. No effect on PDF. Pro only.

output_size.description: Output image width in px. Defaults to viewport_width.

pdf_landscape.description: Render the PDF in landscape orientation (format=pdf only).

pdf_margin_mm.description: PDF page margin in millimetres, 0-50 (format=pdf only). Default 10.

pdf_page_size.description: PDF page size (format=pdf only). Default A4.

prefers_reduced_motion.description: Emulate the prefers-reduced-motion: reduce CSS media feature. Well-built sites use it to skip or shorten animations (framer-motion, GSAP, AOS, IntersectionObserver reveals), so captures show the settled state instead of mid-animation frames. Free tier.

preset.description: Named output bundle | fills viewport_width / output_size / crop_height. og=1200×630 (social card), mobile=390×844 (iPhone), square=1080×1080, reel=1080×1920, pinterest=1000×1500, youtube_thumbnail=1280×720, tablet=768×1024. Pro presets: desktop=1440×900, desktop_hd=1920×1080, twitter_header=1500×500, linkedin_banner=1584×396, hero_banner=1920×600.

render_region.description: Geographic render location, using a real local IP. fr-paris is the default and free; ca-montreal, sg-singapore (beta), au-sydney (beta), vn-hanoi (beta) are Pro.

scroll_before_capture.description: Scroll through the full page before capturing so lazy-loaded content (images, infinite scroll, content below the fold) is rendered. Recommended with fullpage=true. Pro only.

scroll_offset_px.description: Scroll down this many px (0-30000) before capturing, so the frame starts lower. Mutually exclusive with scroll_to. No-op for fullpage/PDF/selector. Pro only.

scroll_to.description: CSS selector for an element to scroll into view (top of frame) before capturing. Typically an element id, e.g. "#pricing". Resolved via querySelector. Unlike selector, it does not clip output. Mutually exclusive with scroll_offset_px; missing element is a no-op. No-op for fullpage/PDF/selector. Pro only.

selector.description: CSS selector: clips output to the matching element. Pro only, non-PDF.

viewport_width.description: Browser viewport width in px. Free: 390, 768, 1280. Shotbot Pro: any custom width 280-3840 (CSS / responsive testing). Default: 1280.

wait.description: Seconds to wait after page load before capture. Free: 0-5, Pro: 0-30. Default: 5.

name: capture
